title: Isolation commanded but not confirmed (relay fails to open)
description: Section A–B parts and the controller commands isolation, but the simulated relay contacts do not open. The feedback contact keeps reporting CLOSED.
what_to_look_for: Feeder stays at 'Isolation commanded – not confirmed'. It is NEVER shown as Isolated.
After the feedback timeout (placeholder 3 s) an ISOLATION_UNCONFIRMED critical alert appears.
Node A keeps supply (the switch did not open).
